```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load and preprocess data
if(!file.exists("activity.csv")){
  unzip("activity.zip")
}
activity <- read.csv("activity.csv")
activity$date <- as.Date(activity$date)

# 1. Mean total number of steps per day
steps_per_day <- activity %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(total_steps = sum(steps, na.rm = TRUE))

# Histogram
hist1 <- ggplot(steps_per_day, aes(x = total_steps)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1000, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Total Steps per Day", x = "Total Steps", y = "Frequency")
print(hist1)

# Mean and median
mean_steps <- mean(steps_per_day$total_steps)
median_steps <- median(steps_per_day$total_steps)

cat("Mean steps per day:", mean_steps, "\n")
cat("Median steps per day:", median_steps, "\n\n")

# 2. Average daily activity pattern
avg_interval <- activity %>%
  group_by(interval) %>%
  summarize(mean_steps = mean(steps, na.rm = TRUE))

# Time series plot
plot2 <- ggplot(avg_interval, aes(x = interval, y = mean_steps)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Average Daily Activity Pattern", x = "Interval", y = "Mean Steps")
print(plot2)

max_interval <- avg_interval$interval[which.max(avg_interval$mean_steps)]
cat("Interval with max average steps:", max_interval, "\n\n")

# 3. Imputing missing values
missing_count <- sum(is.na(activity$steps))
cat("Missing values in original data:", missing_count, "\n")

# Impute missing steps using mean for that interval
activity_imputed <- activity %>%
  group_by(interval) %>%
  mutate(steps = ifelse(is.na(steps), mean(steps, na.rm = TRUE), steps))

# Total steps per day after imputation
steps_day_imputed <- activity_imputed %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(total_steps = sum(steps))

# Histogram after imputation
hist2 <- ggplot(steps_day_imputed, aes(x = total_steps)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1000, fill = "orange", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Total Steps per Day (Imputed)", x = "Total Steps", y = "Frequency")
print(hist2)

# Mean and median after imputation
mean_imp <- mean(steps_day_imputed$total_steps)
median_imp <- median(steps_day_imputed$total_steps)

cat("Mean after imputation:", mean_imp, "\n")
cat("Median after imputation:", median_imp, "\n\n")

# 4. Weekday vs weekend activity
activity_imputed$day_type <- ifelse(weekdays(activity_imputed$date) %in% 
                                      c("Saturday", "Sunday"), "weekend", "weekday")

avg_steps_daytype <- activity_imputed %>%
  group_by(interval, day_type) %>%
  summarize(mean_steps = mean(steps))

# Faceted plot
plot3 <- ggplot(avg_steps_daytype, aes(x = interval, y = mean_steps)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  facet_wrap(~ day_type, ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = "Weekday vs Weekend Activity Patterns", x = "Interval", y = "Average Steps")
print(plot3)
